info.name: The Things Stack — Application Server AppAs NotificationService API

List the notifications for a user or an organization.
When called with user credentials and empty receiver_ids, this will list
notifications for the current user and its organizations.

params.name: receiver_ids.user_id
params.description: This ID shares namespace with organization IDs.

params.name: receiver_ids.email
params.description: Secondary identifier, which can only be used in specific requests.

params.name: status
params.description:
Select notifications with these statuses.
An empty list is interpreted as "all".

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of results per page.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for pagination. 0 is interpreted as 1.
